captions.detailed: A classic benchtop monocular laboratory microscope featuring a heavy, off-white rectangular base with rounded corners and a robust vertical arm. A flat, black rectangular stage is mounted to the arm, complete with two small silver spring clips for holding slides. The assembly includes a long, dark grey observation tube mounted on a vertical slider, a rotating objective nosepiece turret at its base, and two coaxial black focusing knobs attached to a horizontal shaft on the sides of the vertical arm.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated 3D model of a monocular laboratory microscope using CadQuery. The model should feature a heavy off-white foot/base, a vertical support arm, a black rectangular stage with silver slide clips, and a dark grey observation tube. Ensure the observation tube is mounted on a prismatic joint for vertical sliding (focus adjustment) along the arm, and the objective nosepiece turret is rotatable.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject by first defining materials for the main body (off-white), stage/knobs (dark grey/black), and metallic parts. It models the base and vertical arm as a combined rigid frame using box primitives. The stage is built from a thin box with small cylindrical/box clips. The focusing knobs are created using cylinder primitives on a horizontal axis. The observation tube is modeled as a series of concentric cylinders. Prismatic joints are defined for the vertical travel of the tube carriage relative to the arm, and a revolute joint is used for the rotating objective turret.
